title: How to craft attack Rings with 4 flats Poe2 0.5
creator: SaVeQ

base.name: Dusk Ring (inferred; the video never names the base)
base.quote: when it comes to prefixes on the rings, we kind of want four flat damages on to them.

target.text: fracture an elemental T1 flat damage to attacks (cold, fire or lightning, not physical)

steps.quote: We will try to fracture one of the elemental damages. So, I have lightning, I have lightning, I have fire here prepared
steps.note: He explains he avoids physical because its weight is doubled, so physical is left for the desecration.

target.text: second T1 flat damage to attacks (elemental wanted; took T1 physical)

steps.quote: we will annul it down. We going to chaos spam for any other T1 elemental flats.
steps.note: He got T1 physical and kept it (2:57–3:00).

steps.quote: we going to add a suffix modifier. With normal exalted orb, we got all elemental resistances quite good.
steps.note: No side omen is named for this exalt.

target.text: suffix removed, Breach quality mod added so quality can go beyond 20%

steps.quote: activate omen of the Tsar's Crystallisation, essence of breach. This will remove all elemental resistances. And right now we can quality up beyond 20.
steps.note: 'Tsar's Crystallisation' is the caption for Dextral Crystallisation.

target.text: the missing element's T1 flat (cold here)

steps.quote: omen of catalyzed exaltation with an omen of sinister exaltation. This will consume the quality, but it will improve our chances
steps.note: Cold catalyst quality applied just before (3:51–4:06). Hit T1 cold on the first try, which he calls super lucky.

steps.quote: we need to grab ourselves a river catalyst. It's attack, not a damage. Let's quality this up all the way to 40.
steps.note: 'River catalyst' is the caption for Reaver (Attack) catalyst.

target.text: remove the maximum-quality mod, ideally into a suffix slot

steps.quote: we can grab witling. We can kind of whittle with normal chaos orb. You don't want to use greater.

target.text: fill all open suffixes so the desecration can only land in a prefix

steps.quote: fill your suffixes first so the desecration will only go towards the prefixes. So, fill the suffixes with normal X
steps.note: He did this after a failed first desecration (7:32–7:41); the correct order is suffixes first.

target.text: fourth flat: lightning (T1 or T2 wanted)

steps.quote: Doesn't look like we can stick with T1 or T2.
steps.note: T1 or T2 is the acceptance bar for the desecrated flat (6:40–7:01). The method itself: Sinistral Necromancy, Preserved collarbones and Abyssal Echoes (5:49–6:25), Omen of Light removes a poor reveal (7:13–7:18). Got T1 lightning after several rerolls (9:04–9:10).

target.text: all elemental resistances or other resistances; rarity or dexterity acceptable

steps.quote: the last thing to do is whittle onto the suffixes to get either all elemental resistances with any other resistances, that would be good.
steps.note: He stopped at rarity plus cold res and listed it (9:35–9:45).

missHandling.trigger: revealed desecrated mod is poor (low evasion, T4/T5 flat)
missHandling.quote: activate omen of light to remove the desecrated evasion. We can add collar bone. Let's desecrate.

missHandling.trigger: the catalysed slam hits a wrong element (no-chaos alternative route)
missHandling.quote: We got cold damage. You annul it down, and you repeat the process. you going to add the essence again
missHandling.note: Alternative to chaos-spamming the flat: Breach essence, cold catalyst, Catalysing plus Sinistral omens with a Greater Exalted Orb, annul on a miss and redo the essence (10:43–11:55).

qualityPath.orderNote: Cold catalyst quality is consumed by the catalysed prefix slam; Attack catalyst then takes the ring to 40% before the Breach quality mod is whittled away.

measured.context: fracturing orb on four prepared rings (two lightning, two fire T1 flats): two fractured, two missed and sold to vendor; he calls the base chance one in three
measured.quote: One in three. We missed. We missed. We got it, and we got it.

measured.context: physical flat weight is double the elemental flats' (read off the weights; he gives T1 and T2 elemental weights as '241, 342')
measured.quote: we will try to desecrate in the world of souls, the weights of fizz the weights on fizz are doubled.

claims.text: this craft: 120 to 200 div depending on luck
claims.quote: Prepare to spend around 120 to 200 divines depending on the luck.

claims.text: cheaper version 50 to 80 div if not picky with modifiers
claims.quote: you can do this craft for even like 50 to 80 divines if you're not going to be picky with the modifiers.

claims.text: his finished ring: price check 690 div, listed at 650, expected 500 to 600 easily
claims.quote: Looks like uh 690 divines. So, I mean, I will list it at 650. it should sell for around 500 to 600 divines easily.

claims.text: mid-budget ring with T3 flats sells for about 100 to 150 div
claims.quote: This ring would still sell for around 100 to 150 divines, depending on the suffixes

salvage.action: sell the unfractured rings back to vendor
salvage.quote: We missed two. So, right now the only thing we can do is sell them back to vendor.

salvage.when: mid-budget goal, no need for T1 flats
salvage.action: settle for T3 flats (chaos spam or slam for T3, desecrate T3)
salvage.valueClaim: ring sells for about 100 to 150 div
salvage.quote: if you want to go for this mid-budget craft, I mean, you can stick with T3.

caveats: Title says four flats and the plan targets four flat prefixes (0:45–0:50), but the intro says two flat damage rings (0:01–0:03); the final ring's flats are T1 fire, T1 cold, T1 physical (kept) and T1 lightning.

A four-flat-prefix ring is a Dusk Ring craft: three flats are on the ring by 4:36–4:40 and the fourth is revealed at 9:04–9:10, with the Breach quality mod whittled out of a prefix slot in between; quality goes to 40% (3:42–3:44, 5:19–5:24). The base is inferred from the four prefixes (KB §3); the transcript never names it.

SaVeQ (this video, 33) and ASaVeQ (transcripts 23, 27, 30) are very likely the same creator, so they count as ONE creator. ASaVeQ's Dusk Ring video (27, CZepweLtKwA 0:12–0:20: 'the best base, of course, Dusk Ring, so we can have four prefixes') corroborates the base but is not an independent source.

He avoids physical for the fracture because its weight is doubled, and would rather desecrate for lightning or cold since desecrated physical weights are good but lightning's are 'halved' (6:43–6:56).
Desecrated lightning weights quoted as about 200 (T1) and 300 (T3) (8:48–8:58); the number is partly garbled.
Mistake shown: desecrating before filling suffixes (7:32–7:58).
unresolved: Base type and item level are never stated; Dusk Ring is inferred from four prefix flats (KB §3), not named in this transcript.
Whether the bases were bought or crafted from scratch is not stated.
What exactly 'I failed super badly, I forgot to do something' was at 7:32 (apparently desecrating with open suffixes), and what was annulled.
Weights '241, 342' (1:14–1:19) and the Reaver catalyst price '29 for 10' (5:15–5:18) are garbled; units unclear.
Which exalt omen, if any, is used for the plain suffix slams at 3:09 and 8:01.
